lifecycle.play: Title construction creates the source camera/FX prefix before Ui.start creates source timer/control native objects; it does not wait. play requires an active stackful caller, then creates the five source model/label/audio/input/initializer process graph. Getters borrow only for parent's exclusive graphics preparation; the camera and empty FX prefix also exist before play.
lifecycle.retirement: Main explicitly guarantees every graphics RSP/RDP task and native/producer view has actually completed/ceased BEFORE the next isle_game_tick. Optional presentation holds separate copied tile leases. Play cleanup ends title processes, detaches/resets FX, retires/destroys model Producer while model objects remain alive, retires/destroys Runtime, then source-deletes model/label/audio/input/initializer objects and camera. Source FX native callback objects survive until full Title.retire/scene cessation; empty/reset FX callbacks continue in native OM update order. Catalog/common canonical RAM remain parent-owned/live.
lifecycle.reentry: Fresh play creates fresh native model/camera/animation owners and source fields, resets retained FX, and repositions a newly recreated process-free camera before the surviving FX/UI prefix before adding its actual animation process. No retired model view or frozen animation state is reused; native arena metadata recycles. Full scene reentry reconstructs Title prefix before UI startup. Title does not terminate parent GTL/session or mutate source start_flags.
